home.title: Your next opportunity in Morocco
home.subtitle: Jobs, internships, degree programmes, scholarships and concours, collected daily from public sources and sorted by deadline.

emptyFiltered.title: No opportunities match your filters
emptyFiltered.body: Try widening your search. Remove a field or city, or extend the deadline window.

emptyDatabase.title: No open opportunities yet
emptyDatabase.body: The database is reachable but empty. Run the ingestion job and reload.

notConfigured.title: Supabase is not configured yet
notConfigured.body: Copy web/.env.example to web/.env.local and fill in your project URL and anon key, then reload.

detail.collectedFrom: Collected from {source} on {date}. Always confirm the details on the issuing site before applying.

auth.signInSubtitle: To save opportunities, get recommendations that fit your profile, and be emailed when something new matches.
auth.linkSent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It is valid for one hour.
auth.browsingNote: Browsing works without an account. Signing in only adds the personal features.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: The more of this you fill in, the better the recommendations get.
profile.name: Name
profile.lookingForHelp: Used to rank the "Recommended for you" list and to decide which new listings are worth emailing you about.
profile.emailAlertsToggle: Email me when a new opportunity matches my profile
profile.reminderDays: Remind me before a saved deadline

recommendations.title: Recommended for you
recommendations.emptyBody: Tell us your level, fields and the kinds of opportunity you want, and this list fills with what fits.

reasons.type: Matches the type you are looking for

saved.title: Saved
saved.closingSoon: {count} of your saved opportunities close within a week.
saved.reminderNote: You will also get an email reminder. Adjust the timing in your {profileLink}.
saved.emptyBody: Save anything you are considering and it will show up here, with a reminder before it closes.

admin.title: Scraper health
admin.subtitle: A source that starts failing usually means the site changed its markup. The warnings column fills up before a scraper breaks outright.

footer.disclaimer: Listings are collected from public sources and link back to the original announcement. Always confirm details on the issuing site before applying.
